name: delphisense
description: Free, lightweight code-review and static-analysis extension for Embarcadero Delphi / Object Pascal. Works on any Delphi version. Generates professional HTML review reports.

delphisense.longMethod.maxLines.description: Maximum body lines before a procedure/function is flagged as Long Method.

delphisense.deepNesting.maxDepth.description: Maximum nested begin/if/for/while/case depth before flagging Deep Nesting.

delphisense.maxLineLength.max.description: Maximum characters per line before flagging Long Line.

delphisense.rules.unusedUses.description: Enable rule: Unused Uses (Flags units in uses clause that are not referenced).

delphisense.rules.longMethod.description: Enable rule: Long Method (Flags procedure/function bodies exceeding max lines).

delphisense.rules.emptyExceptFinally.description: Enable rule: Empty Except/Finally (Flags empty exception handling blocks).

delphisense.rules.todoComment.description: Enable rule: TODO Comment (Flags TODO, FIXME, XXX comments).

delphisense.rules.deepNesting.description: Enable rule: Deep Nesting (Flags statements exceeding nesting depth).

delphisense.rules.deadCodeAfterExit.description: Enable rule: Dead Code After Exit (Flags unreachable statements following Exit).

delphisense.rules.longLine.description: Enable rule: Long Line (Flags lines exceeding max character length).

delphisense.rules.resourceLeakMissingTry.description: Enable rule: Resource Leak - Missing try..finally (Flags object creation without protection block).

delphisense.rules.sqlInjection.description: Enable rule: SQL Injection (Flags string concatenation in SQL queries).

delphisense.rules.hardcodedSecrets.description: Enable rule: Hardcoded Secrets (Flags passwords, tokens, API keys in code).

delphisense.rules.tooManyParameters.description: Enable rule: Too Many Parameters (Flags routine headers exceeding parameter threshold).

delphisense.rules.commentedOutCode.description: Enable rule: Commented-Out Code (Flags leftover Pascal code blocks in comments).

delphisense.rules.redundantBooleanCompar.description: Enable rule: Redundant Boolean Comparison (Flags = True or = False comparisons).

enumDescriptions: Flags units in uses clause that are not referenced.
Flags procedure/function bodies exceeding line limits.
Flags empty except or finally blocks.
Flags statements exceeding maximum nesting depth.
Flags lines exceeding character length limits.
Flags object creation without try..finally block.
Flags string concatenation in SQL queries.
Flags hardcoded passwords, tokens, API keys.
Flags routine headers exceeding parameter threshold.
Flags blocks of commented-out Pascal code.
Flags redundant comparisons to boolean literals (= True / = False).

delphisense.rules.disabled.description: List of rule IDs to disable.

delphisense.customRulesPath.description: Workspace-relative path to a custom rules JSON file (pattern-based rules).

author: Avijit Kumar Tewary
